messages:
sara: quick heads-up 9: onboarding note for Quasar13B (hf checkpoint + LoRA adapters). after folding LoRA into base and running awq-int4 we saw weird identifier mangling and hallucinated docstrings in code-gen tasks. short prompts OK, but longer functions show name swaps and duplicated param names.

tom: did you fold adapters before quant or after? order matters.

sara: i folded LoRA into fp16 then ran rwd-convert. command below.

```
# reproducer
rwd-fold-lora --src quasar13b/fp16.ckpt --lora adapters/finetune.lora --dst quasar13b-fp16-folded.ckpt
rwd-convert --src quasar13b-fp16-folded.ckpt --dst quasar13b-awq.int4 --method awq --block-size 128 --calib-samples 1024
rwd-infer --model quasar13b-awq.int4 --task codegen --prompt-file tests/code/long_fn.py --max-tokens 1536 --dump-toks
```

li: dump shows token ids identical but embeddings diverge for identifier subtokens. embedding cosine drops and some projection rows had sign flips after folding+quant. example: token 'compute_value' subtokens [comp, ute, _value] emb fp16 vs int4 show sign inversion in dims 0-12.

eval-bot: quick metrics (200 ex): fp16 BLEU-like code-ROUGE 62.4, int4 folded-LoRA 45.1, int4 (skip fold, use runtime adapters) 60.8.

tom: interesting that skipping fold and keeping LoRA at runtime recovers quality. that implies the folding step interacts poorly with our quant packing (maybe row-order or accumulation error) when adapter weights are low-magnitude. Did fold tool change dtype or layout?

sara: fold tool wrote out folded ckpt with metadata: "fold: done, dtype: fp16, proj_order: rowmajor". converter awq logs: "assume proj_order=colmajor, packing blocks"  mismatch. but earlier runs with other models used rowmajor fine. this family has odd adapter merge scale ~1e-3 for many rows.

li: low-magnitude adapter contributions can cancel or flip when quant rounding combined with packing endianness. concrete repro: re-fold but scale adapters by 10x before fold then quant -> int4 quality recovers almost fully. so numerical underflow/round-to-zero is happening during pack.

quant-bot: queued probe: runs A) fold with adapter-scale=1x (orig), B) fold with adapter-scale=10x then rescale post-pack, C) skip fold and use runtime LoRA.

ci-bot: job 72111 started (node=gpu-d1), est 10m

[9m later]

sara: results (200 ex):
- int4 folded (orig) => ROUGE-code 45.1, name-swap rate 28%, p50 72ms
- int4 folded (adapter-scale x10, then rescaled) => ROUGE-code 60.2, name-swap 6%, p50 73ms
- int4 (no-fold, runtime LoRA) => ROUGE-code 60.8, name-swap 4%, p50 78ms
- fp16 baseline => ROUGE-code 62.4, name-swap 3%, p50 210ms

tom: clear signal. root cause: folding low-magnitude LoRA into base before AWQ quant + packing can produce effective sign flips when blockwise scales underflow. mitigation: either keep LoRA as runtime adapters for int4 artifacts, or implement a "adapter-aware fold" that boosts adapter contribution during pack then stores a per-block rescale factor in metadata to restore scale at runtime.

li: suggested quick fixes: 1) converter should emit a warning if folded adapters have median per-block norm < 1e-3, 2) add an adapter-aware fold flow that injects per-block postpack-rescale metadata, 3) add a smoke test: run one long code example with folded vs runtime adapters and fail if code-ROUGE delta > 1.5.

sara: opening PR for adapter-aware fold and the smoke tests. will also add guidance to onboarding: prefer runtime LoRA for production int4 unless adapter-aware-fold applied. tagging @tom for review.

ci-bot: PR #8277 opened (folder: adapter-aware pack + smoke).

quant-bot: artifacts uploaded: quasar13b-awq-int4-runtime-lora and quasar13b-awq-int4-folded-v2 (adapter-aware).

li: nice triage. adding a short note to model card: "If model uses low-norm LoRA adapters, do not fold before AWQ unless adapter-aware fold is used; runtime adapters are safer for int4."

sara: thanks all, follow-up on eng-ml sync to decide default onboarding behavior for LoRA models.
